reviews.t: Oz Naturals: 2.5% Retinol Serum with Astaxanthin and Vitamin E Review
reviews.x: The market is filled with ant-aging products and even though we have many too choose from, some rarely work. Thankfully, Oz Naturals was not

reviews.t: Oz Naturals are awesome products. See my review on the Cleanser
reviews.x: Oz Naturals are awesome products.  See my review on the Cleanser.  I have used these products for almost a year.  I started with the cleanser, AHA and C serums.  I liked them so well that I expanded my collection to include the Eye Gel, Retinol Moisturizer, and this facial mask.  I am 61 and had a woman today who was complaining about turning 50 this year.  I jokingly told her to wait another 11 years.  She was shocked at my age and thought I was younger than her.  I get that a lot!!  Thank you

reviews.t: I like it, I have no complains
reviews.x: Give it time. Anything you buy to change something in your life, just give it some time to explain itself. At least a month. What's all this "give me a miracle now, or..." mentality? And what's all this "it worked over night" confessions?  ( it's all psychological.) I had to use this for a month first to see some real changes. The second bottle was thicker but same color. I like it, I have no complains. Make your skin happy with simple steps. Vitamin C + Rosehip Seed Oil + Fish O

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the serum as gentle on the skin, even though it is a strong retinol.
Many reviewers report visible improvements in skin smoothness, tone, and fine lines or wrinkles.
Several reviewers note the serum is lightweight, absorbs well, and is not sticky or greasy.
Some reviewers emphasize that results take time and advise giving the product at least a month rather than expecting an overnight miracle.
A few reviewers mention using the serum alongside other Oz Naturals products such as Vitamin C serum.
